newsitem.title: USA: Latin Communications names Martin Payson chairman.
newsitem.headline: Latin Communications names Martin Payson chairman.

text.p: Latin Communications Group on Tuesday said it named Martin Payson chairman of its board.

The privately held media company said in a statement that Payson, a former Time Warner Inc vice chairman, would keep his responsibilities as a director of the group. Payson replaces James Harmon, the president and chairman of the Export-Import Bank in Washington.

Latin Communications owns and operates 15 U.S. Spanish-language radio stations; two English-language radio stations; three Spanish-language television stations; and the Spanish-language daily El Diario/La Prensa.
